in_latin.name: Cleo
in_latin.long_meaning: Cleo in Latin signifies glory, fame, renown, or celebrity. It is derived from the Greek word Κλέος (Kléos), which conveys the idea of honor, praise, or reputation. In the context of early Christian church, Cleo represents the glory of God, reflecting the saints' devotion to the divine. This name has been chosen by Christian parents due to its spiritual significance and representation of Christian values.
